machine_contract.cs_timing_encoding: USER1 CS_SETUP_TIME stores cycles minus one; CS_HOLD_TIME stores raw cycles. HOLD enabled with CS_HOLD_TIME=0 appends no extra cycle and DONE occurs at the final data edge.
machine_contract.strict_pause_observation: Under libqtest's qtest accelerator, CONT starts dummy vCPU threads, not firmware. Overflow/unknown-RX tests require a real QMP RESUME then STOP and query-status=paused, with persistent USR, no DONE and unchanged PIO storage. An initial -S state alone is not accepted as proof of strict pause.
